en.summary: The LTX-2.5 video generation model can now run on Amazon's Trainium3 chips to produce videos.

items.title: AI智能体已接管DeepMind部分算力，用于Gemini实验
items.summary: DeepMind让AI智能体参与管理部分计算资源，用于Gemini模型的实验。
items.lede: DeepMind表示，AI智能体已接管部分算力，用于Gemini实验。
analysis: DeepMind发布消息称，AI智能体已开始控制其部分算力，用于Gemini相关实验。
目前公开的信息没有给出具体算力比例或效率变化数据。
这意味着部分实验的资源调度可能由AI自行完成，而非全部由人工安排。

en.title: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments
en.summary: DeepMind has let AI agents manage some of its computing resources for experiments on the Gemini model.
en.lede: DeepMind says AI agents now control part of its compute for Gemini experiments.
analysis: DeepMind said AI agents have begun controlling part of its compute for Gemini-related experiments.
The public information does not give a specific share of compute or any change in efficiency.
This means some experiment scheduling may be handled by AI itself rather than entirely by people.

items.title: 英国首次：AI代理不用银行卡完成购物
items.summary: 一个AI代理在英国首次不用银行卡完成了一笔购买。
items.lede: 英国首次出现AI代理不用银行卡完成购物。
analysis: 英国出现首例由AI代理完成的免银行卡购物。
这次购买没有使用实体卡或卡号，具体金额和参与方未披露。
如果这种支付方式推广，AI代理可以替人下单，但安全和授权问题仍需解决。

en.title: UK first: AI agent completes purchase without a bank card
en.summary: An AI agent has made a purchase in the UK without using a bank card, a first for the country.
en.lede: An AI agent in the UK has completed a purchase without a bank card, a first for the country.
analysis: The UK has seen its first purchase completed by an AI agent without a bank card.
The purchase involved no physical card or card number; the amount and parties involved were not disclosed.
If the payment method spreads, AI agents could order on people's behalf, but security and authorization questions remain.
